[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Telegram reply-to context loss — PR1: fix + tests
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/500
  
  Details:
  Telegram reply-to context loss — PR1: fix + tests.
  
  Root cause: Telegram hands the bot the replied-to message's full content in
  `reply_to_message`, but app/telegram_adapter.py read it only for two narrow
  checks (the mention-gate bypass at ~line 615 and an unrelated topic-creation
  probe at ~line 1972). Replying to a specific prior message (e.g. a photo)
  silently dropped that relationship before it reached the LLM (found live
  2026-09-24, second occurrence).
  
  Fix (at the plan's §1.2 dispatch_text construction site, alongside the existing
  [Telegram context: ...] prefix — same convention as [GOVERNOR_IDENTITY: ...]):
  new pure helpers _format_reply_time / _describe_media / _reply_context_prefix
  build a `[Replying to <who>, sent <when>: "<snippet>"]` bracketed prefix.
  Captioned/text reply -> quoted snippet (400-char cap). Uncaptioned
  photo/document -> an honest marker that a reply to that media happened, from
  whom and when, since no vision-passing path exists in the current LLM call
  (§1.3, explicitly out of scope). Returns "" when not a reply, so dispatch_text
  stays BYTE-IDENTICAL for non-replies.
  
  Tests: 11 added to tests/test_telegram_adapter.py — not-a-reply empty; text
  reply; captioned photo; uncaptioned photo; document; long-quote truncation;
  two exact-string no-reply regression guards; two end-to-end handle_message
  dispatch assertions. 109 passed locally. ruff: 0 new lint vs main.
  
  Build-time env: truesight_autopilot @ fix/telegram-reply-context.
  
  PR: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/500
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
